nodes.title: USER MANUAL
widgets_values:
Keep the final workflow disabled.
Place an image with one or more people and render. It will assign a mask number to each person.
Choose and set a mask number.
Now, enable the final workflow, set a LoRA and a prompt, then render.
It will modify the selected person.

nodes.title: SWITCH ON ALL TO USE STYLE TRANSFER
USER MANUAL
widgets_values:
Place an image, mask the area you want to change, write a prompt, use LoRA if needed, and render.

You can use the Redux node for image sampling. It will copy the style and add it to the inpainted area of the output image.

Adjust the SAMPLER Denoise strength if needed
